overall: The AG found no violation: the Open Meeting Law requires minutes to be available on request within 10 days, not posted online, and no request had been made before the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by not posting the minutes of three meetings to the city's municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require public bodies to post meeting minutes.
